description: A man in a dark apron and rolled sleeves stands on a wooden ladder against a red brick townhouse, troweling mortar into a window opening. He holds a board of bricks in one hand and a trowel in the other. Below him a wooden bucket sits on a plank beside a lower window. On the street a man in a tricorn hat and long coat holds a paper and points up at the ladder, with onlookers and a cobbled lane behind. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border visible.
